run_average_submissions: run average_submissions to ensemble model predictions from a grid of submission folders
run_average_submissions_weighted: run average_submissions with score-based weighting and per-voxel softmax weights for ensembling
run_select_diverse_subset: run select_diverse_subset to greedily pick k most diverse indices from a correlation matrix
run_get_k_most_diverse_indices: run get_k_most_diverse_indices to find the k least correlated predictors from submission data
review_average_submissions: review average_submissions to understand how grid submissions are loaded, weighted, and averaged
